description: Experimental TP2 fixed DarTree with eight GPU MTP rounds and up to 64 proposals plus root. Exact Bole GDN replay preserves FP32/BF16/INT8 intermediates. Private ancestor-aware target attention uses FP32 QK, softmax, PV and split partials with BF16 output; attention order changes without reducing intermediate precision. This configuration is not a gate PASS or a performance claim.
